pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions exhibit high-contrast, sharp-edged polygonal geometries. Morphology varies from large, sub-quadrangular shapes on the upper neck to smaller, irregular, multi-angled polygons on the lower neck and flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-colored interstitial pathways form a continuous, high-contrast grid. These negative-space corridors maintain relatively uniform pixel thickness, connected by prominent three-way and four-way junction nodes across the lateral surface.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The dorsal mane presents a jagged, high-frequency 1D silhouette with low-amplitude vertical extensions against the background.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A distinct structural discontinuity in the mane's continuous line is visible at the vertex where the lower neck meets the shoulder ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple dark, avian-shaped silhouettes (oxpeckers) are localized along the dorsal mane and the lateral neck region.
